summary: Mautic 7 is a PHP/Symfony/Doctrine marketing-automation platform: contacts (Leads) with segments, companies, tags, points and lifecycle stages; marketing channels (Email, Campaign, Form, Page, Asset, Sms, Webhook, Channel, DynamicContent, PushNotification); and User/Role/Permission RBAC with OAuth2 clients. It is a stateful CRUD app - contacts, emails, campaigns, segments, forms, pages and assets are created/edited/deleted by controllers, and every write is permission-gated via the Permission bitwise table (a role must hold a bundle:entity:action permission for the tool to run).
